import sys
import math

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    a, b, n = map(int, data)
    best_diff = float('inf')
    best_x = 0
    best_y = 0
    for j in range(1, n + 1):
        floor_val = (j * a) // b
        for i in range(floor_val - 1, floor_val + 2):
            diff = abs(i / j - a / b)
            if diff < best_diff:
                best_diff = diff
                best_x = i
                best_y = j
    g = math.gcd(best_x, best_y)
    sys.stdout.write(f"{best_x // g}/{best_y // g}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
